about: The BURROW: your own hardware running k3s. One definition, two bodies — the real machines (./securax spore) and a Docker twin that rehearses them on a laptop. Both read THIS file, so the twin cannot drift from the hardware.

k3s_installer.note: Pinned by hash: the script is downloaded to a file and checked BEFORE it runs (never piped into a shell). The script then verifies the k3s binary against the release checksums itself. Re-pin on every k3s bump: curl -fsSL <url> | sha256sum.
